hypothesis: If two clients interleave after reading the same cart, both will successfully insert and commit a payment, causing more than one successful payment.
expected_observable: payment_count will increase from 1 to 2 while ticket_count remains unchanged and response_status stays 200 for both responses.
reason: This intervention directly creates a race condition where two independent transactions can commit payments on the same cart, testing the invariant without depending on client retry logic or message loss, making it a stronger test than delaying or dropping responses.

ranked_candidates.rationale: Creates concurrent conflicting writes that can directly violate the at-most-one-payment invariant.
Allows a client to retry after payment commit, potentially causing a second payment if the server is not idempotent.
Similar to delay but loses the acknowledgment entirely; relies on client timeout behavior, making it slightly less direct.
